analysis.summary: Today's tech headlines highlight a mix of regulatory issues, AI advancements, and business news. Notable stories include Vinted blocking sexually explicit ads, the Deepfake 'nudify' site being fined for lack of age checks, and an AI 'godfather' leaving Meta after 12 years. In business, US stocks slid due to Wall Street's AI concerns, while Channel Tunnel halted projects citing UK investment as non-viable. Other significant events include Zelensky discussing a proposed peace plan with Trump and COP30 climate talks being evacuated following a fire. In the tech world, Google stepped up protection against AI scams in India, WhatsApp introduced an Instagram Notes-like feature, and Microsoft open-sourced Zork I, II, and III.
